hook: No Cherry Blossom Blooms All Year

voices.name: l00
voices.text: If cherry blossoms bloomed all year, <#0.2#> would they still move us?
voices.caption: If cherry blossoms bloomed all year, would they still move us?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Because they fall in a few days, <#0.2#> this moment is beautiful.
voices.caption: Because they fall in a few days, this moment is beautiful.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: In Bhutan, there's said to be a saying: <#0.2#> think about death five times a day.
voices.caption: In Bhutan, there's said to be a saying: think about death five times a day.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: That morning on the train, staring at your phone. <#0.3#> If it were your last morning, would you have spent it that way?
voices.caption: That morning on the train, staring at your phone. If it were your last morning, would you have spent it that way?

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Because it ends, <#0.2#> today is a day that will never come again.
voices.caption: Because it ends, today is a day that will never come again.
